title: Compatibility of the inclusions $E_X\to F_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$
statement:
For finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every scheme $X$, the
inclusion $E_X\to F_X$ ([def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map]) followed by $F_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is
the inclusion $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ ([def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]).

proof.text: Let $\iota_{E,F}\colon\underline E\to\underline F$ be the postcomposition inclusion of [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map], and let $j_H\colon\underline H\to\underline{\Qlb}$ for $H=E,F$ be the inclusions of [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]. For each profinite test object $S$ and continuous $h\colon S\to E$, both $j_F\circ\iota_{E,F}$ and $j_E$ send $h$ to the same map $S\to E\subseteq\Qlb$. This is precisely the equality $j_F\circ\iota_{E,F}=j_E$ stated in the latter node, in the underlying ring objects of condensed abelian sheaves.

By [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map], the map $E_X\to F_X$ is $(\iota_{E,F})_X$. By the current [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map], which specifies the condensed inclusion of step 1, applied once to $F$ and once to $E$, the other two maps are $(j_F)_X\colon F_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ and $(j_E)_X\colon E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$, between the specified pulled-back coefficient rings $H_X=p_X^*\underline H$ and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=p_X^*\underline{\Qlb}$. Apply [lem-sfb-coefficient-map-comp] to $a=\iota_{E,F}$ and $b=j_F$. Its current statement specifies $c_X=p_X^*c$ for underlying condensed abelian morphisms, so the equation is in the same sheaf category as these maps. Consequently $(j_F)_X\circ(\iota_{E,F})_X=(j_F\circ\iota_{E,F})_X=(j_E)_X$, the last equality being substitution of step 1. This is the required equality of the three coefficient-ring maps.
